maker.description: Address of wallet making the order. Example: `0xF296178d553C8Ec21A2fBD2c5dDa8CA9ac905A00`

source.description: Domain of your app that is creating the order, e.g. `myapp.xyz`. This is used for filtering, and to attribute the "order source" of sales in on-chain analytics, to help your app get discovered. Lean more here

blurAuth.description: Advanced use case to pass personal blurAuthToken; the API will generate one if left empty.

token.description: Bid on a particular token. Example: `0x8d04a8c79ceb0889bdd12acdf3fa9d207ed3ff63:123`

tokenSetId.description: Bid on a particular token set. Cannot be used with cross-posting to OpenSea. Example: `token:CONTRACT:TOKEN_ID` representing a single token within contract, `contract:CONTRACT` representing a whole contract, `range:CONTRACT:START_TOKEN_ID:END_TOKEN_ID` representing a continuous token id range within a contract and `list:CONTRACT:TOKEN_IDS_HASH` representing a list of token ids within a contract.

collection.description: Bid on a particular collection with collection-id. Example: `0x8d04a8c79ceb0889bdd12acdf3fa9d207ed3ff63`

attributeKey.description: Bid on a particular attribute key. This is case sensitive. Example: `Composition`

attributeValue.description: Bid on a particular attribute value. This is case sensitive. Example: `Teddy (#33)`

quantity.description: Quantity of tokens to bid on.

weiPrice.description: Amount bidder is willing to offer in the smallest denomination for the specific currency. Example: `1000000000000000000`

orderKind.description: Exchange protocol used to create order. Example: `seaport-v1.5`

orderbook.description: Orderbook where order is placed. Example: `Reservoir`

orderbookApiKey.description: Optional API key for the target orderbook

automatedRoyalties.description: If true, royalty amounts and recipients will be set automatically.

royaltyBps.description: Set a maximum amount of royalties to pay, rather than the full amount. Only relevant when using automated royalties. 1 BPS = 0.01% Note: OpenSea does not support values below 50 bps.

excludeFlaggedTokens.description: If true flagged tokens will be excluded

listingTime.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) indicating when listing will be listed. Example: `1656080318`

expirationTime.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) indicating when listing will expire. Example: `1656080318`

salt.description: Optional. Random string to make the order unique

usePermit.description: When true, will use permit to avoid approvals.

checkMakerOutstandingBalance.description: Check if the maker has enough balance to cover all open bid orders (of the current token / collection / attribute type)

customRoyalties.description: List of custom royalties (formatted as `feeRecipient:feeBps`) to be bundled within the order. 1 BPS = 0.01% Example: `0xF296178d553C8Ec21A2fBD2c5dDa8CA9ac905A00:100`

marketplaceFees.description: List of marketplace fees (formatted as `feeRecipient:feeBps`) to be bundled within the order. 1 BPS = 0.01% Example: `0xF296178d553C8Ec21A2fBD2c5dDa8CA9ac905A00:100`

marketplaceFlatFees.description: List of marketplace flat fees (formatted as `feeRecipient:weiAmount`) to be bundled within the order.
